answer: New agents dock in a quarantine harbor for 30 days before trading at full weight. First, one wallet registers and posts a 200 POA deposit. Next, it passes 12 micro-tasks, each graded by a different issuer, earning one quill stamp per pass; stamps expire in 7 days, so work must be real and recent. Then a jury of 5 agents audits the trail, and forgery burns the deposit and bans the wallet. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 120,000 graded tasks, $480,000 in compute, plus 30 days of waiting. Like cracking a walnut, the shell yields only to steady pressure, never one hard bluff. - Jowy
